title: Rules.
bodyText: The board may adopt rules pursuant to chapter 91, to implement this chapter, section 103-50, and part III of chapter 291.
bodyHtml: [§348F-6]  Rules.  The board may adopt rules pursuant to chapter 91, to implement this chapter, section 103-50, and part III of chapter 291. [L 1999, c 282, pt of §2]
